lawyer:
For the Petitioner: Mr. Md. Aftab Hossain, Advocate-on-Record. 
For the Respondents: None represented.

Md. Arshed ------ Petitioner.
Versus
Akbar Hossain Pathan and others ------ Respondents.
full_judgment: 5. Mr. Md. Aftab Hossain, learned Advocate-on-Record, appearing for the petitioner submitted that the High Court Division as well as the trial Court committed error of law in not considering the fact of the prosecution case stated in the FIR by the informant of the case who has already been proved by the P.W.s; that the finding of the trial Court disbelieving the evidence on record without assessing and judicially considering the evidence on record acquitted the accused persons on presumption and surmise; that the High Court Division without discussing the evidence of the prosecution witnesses and without considering the materials on the record came to the conclusion illegally in holding that they found no cogent ground to interfere with the judgment and order of acquittal passed by the trial Court occasioning failure of justice. The teamed Advocate further submitted that the revision petition upon which the Rule has been issued is not legally maintainable and discharged the Rule illegally occasioning failure of justice; that the informant could have maintained a revision petition under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure if he had obtained permission from the Solicitor to make such an application. But no permission is necessary only a notice is to be served upon the Solicitor as to whether the State will file any appeal before the High Court Division against the order of acquittal within 6(six) months from the date of judgment of the trial Court and if no reply is given by the Solicitor the complainant will file the criminal Revision petition against the order of acquittal before the High Court Division with the information that the State will not file appeal in this case.
